title: Government announces that drinking coffee prevents all diseases, scientists say
text: A viral social media post claims that a new government-backed study proves drinking several cups of coffee every day prevents every known disease. The claim provides no scientific evidence or official source.
subject: News Agency

title: Scientists discover miracle plant that makes people live to 150
text: An online article says researchers discovered a plant that can extend human life to 150 years. The article does not identify a published study or research institution supporting the claim.
subject: Online News

title: Celebrity becomes president after secret midnight election
text: A widely shared story claims a famous actor was secretly elected president during a midnight ceremony. No election authority or reputable news organization reported such an event.
subject: Viral Blog

title: Mobile phone battery can be charged fully by placing it in sunlight
text: A misleading post says smartphones can be fully charged in minutes by leaving them directly under strong sunlight. Technology experts warn that this can heat and damage a phone.
subject: Social Media

title: Scientists say eating only chocolate can replace all meals
text: A fabricated report claims researchers have developed a chocolate diet that provides every nutrient required by the human body. No credible medical research supports the claim.
subject: Viral Website

title: New law gives every citizen free luxury cars
text: A website claims the government has passed a law promising a free luxury vehicle to every citizen. The report does not provide an official government notification or legislation.
subject: Fake News Site

title: Drinking salt water cures every viral infection
text: A false health article claims that drinking concentrated salt water immediately cures viral infections. Medical authorities do not recommend this treatment.
subject: Health Blog

title: School examinations cancelled permanently across the country
text: A social media post claims all school examinations have been permanently cancelled. No education department announcement supports the claim.
subject: Social Media

title: Internet users will receive free laptops from a secret government scheme
text: A viral message asks people to share their personal information to receive a free laptop under an alleged government scheme. No official scheme is cited.
subject: Viral Message

title: Researchers invent device that predicts every future event
text: A sensational article claims a research team has built a machine capable of predicting every future event with perfect accuracy. No credible scientific evidence is provided.
subject: Online Blog

title: Government will shut down the internet every weekend
text: A fabricated report says the government plans to shut down internet services nationwide every weekend. It cites no official notification or telecommunications authority.
subject: Fake News Site

title: Eating one fruit permanently increases intelligence
text: A viral health story claims eating one particular fruit permanently raises intelligence. The report gives no credible research evidence for the claim.
subject: Viral Blog
